title: Lior and the Echo
author: Emrys Underhill
blurb: Ada Marchetti, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
